notes.30: Question 30 was done well, but some candidates lifted too much material from the text and did not gain the mark for the justification. On Question 31 , candidates tended to select the wrong part of the text to correct the statement. On Question 34 , candidates needed to manipulate the text in their answer to gain the mark. Exercise 2 Questions 35–40 This final exercise was intended to be the most challenging part of the paper. Candidates did not gain the marks if they included information that was not necessary to answer the question. Some candidates left answers blank in this exercise and only a minority scored full marks. Questions 35 , 36 and 39 were answered well. On Question 37 , candidates did not always lift the text carefully enough and, on Question 38 , some candidates answered with bons conseils rather than teachers having more experience. The answer to Question 40 required a manipulation of the text to gain the mark. Cambridge International General Certificate of Secondary Education 0520 French November 2020
